claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says people manifest who they are rather than simply what they want; clarity and action help direct outcomes.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says desires without focus remain unfinished plans.

claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says concentrated fear can manifest an egregor, which forms faster and stronger when many people share the fear.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She links this to fear's ability to focus attention.

claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says subconscious programming shapes manifestation; positive outcomes require focused alignment with what one wants to become.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She recommends shadow work to address unconscious programming.
